001package com.streamConverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.CommandResult;
004import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.context.ExecutionContext;
008import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
009import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
010import java.io.IOException;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.util.List;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * StreamConverterのMDC機能統合デモ
018 *
019 * <p>このデモでは、StreamConverterに統合されたMDC機能により、デフォルトでMDC同期が有効になることを示します。
020 */
021public class StreamConverterMDCDemo {
022  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamConverterMDCDemo.class);
023
024  /**
025   * Main method to demonstrate StreamConverter MDC integration.
026   *
027   * @param args command line arguments (not used)
028   * @throws IOException if file operations fail
029   */
030  public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
031    logger.info("🚀 StreamConverter MDC Integration Demo");
032
033    demonstrateAutomaticMDC();
034    demonstrateCustomContext();
035    demonstrateMultipleCommandsMDC();
036
037    logger.info("✅ All demonstrations completed successfully!");
038  }
039
040  /** デモ1: 自動MDC生成 */
041  private static void demonstrateAutomaticMDC() throws IOException {
042    logger.info("📊 Demo 1: Automatic MDC Generation");
043
044    // 既存のAPIを使用 - MDCが自動的に有効化される
045    SampleStreamCommand command = new SampleStreamCommand("auto-mdc");
046    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(command);
047
048    String testData = "id,name,department\n1,Alice,Engineering\n2,Bob,Marketing\n";
049    ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
050        new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
051    ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
052
053    logger.info("Executing pipeline with automatic MDC...");
054    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
055
056    String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
057    logger.info(
058        "Demo 1 completed. Results: {} commands, Output length: {} characters\n",
059        results.size(),
060        result.length());
061  }
062
063  /** デモ2: カスタムコンテキストでのMDC */
064  private static void demonstrateCustomContext() throws IOException {
065    logger.info("🎯 Demo 2: Custom ExecutionContext with MDC");
066
067    // カスタムExecutionContextを作成
068    ExecutionContext customContext =
069        ExecutionContext.builder()
070            .globalContext("requestId", "REQ-DEMO-456")
071            .globalContext("userId", "demo-user")
072            .globalContext("sessionId", "session-789")
073            .userContext("businessUnit", "development")
074            .userContext("priority", "high")
075            .build();
076
077    String testData = "transaction,amount,currency\n1,100.50,USD\n2,75.25,EUR\n";
078
079    // カスタムコンテキストでコンバーター作成
080    SampleStreamCommand enrichmentCommand = new SampleStreamCommand("enrichment");
081    SampleStreamCommand auditCommand = new SampleStreamCommand("audit");
082    StreamConverter converter =
083        StreamConverter.createWithContext(customContext, enrichmentCommand, auditCommand);
084
085    ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
086        new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
087    ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
088
089    logger.info("Executing pipeline with custom context...");
090    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
091
092    String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
093    logger.info(
094        "Demo 2 completed. ExecutionId: {}, Results: {} commands",
095        customContext.getExecutionId(),
096        results.size());
097    logger.info("Output length: {} characters\n", result.length());
098  }
099
100  /** デモ3: 複数コマンドでのMDC同期 */
101  private static void demonstrateMultipleCommandsMDC() throws IOException {
102    logger.info("🔀 Demo 3: Multiple Commands with MDC Synchronization");
103
104    String testData = "product,price,category\nLaptop,999.99,Electronics\nBook,19.99,Education\n";
105
106    // 複数のコマンドでパイプライン構築
107    SampleStreamCommand validator = new SampleStreamCommand("validator");
108    CsvNavigateCommand extractor = new CsvNavigateCommand("product");
109    SampleStreamCommand formatter = new SampleStreamCommand("formatter");
110
111    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(validator, extractor, formatter);
112
113    ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
114        new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
115    ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
116
117    logger.info("Executing multi-command pipeline with MDC synchronization...");
118    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
119
120    String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
121    logger.info("Demo 3 completed. Results: {} commands executed", results.size());
122    logger.info("Final output: {}", result.trim());
123    logger.info("All commands completed with MDC synchronization\n");
124  }
125}
